title: Schalke relegated after 30 years in the Bundesliga - worldfootball.net
content: A 1-0 loss at Arminia Bielefeld confirmed a fourth relegation in Schalke's history after three decades in Germany's top flight.

title: 3 teams, 2 relegation spots, 26 points: chaos in the Bundesliga 🤯 - Yahoo Sports
content: # 3 teams, 2 relegation spots, 26 points: chaos in the Bundesliga 🤯. The Bundesliga delivers thrills even at the bottom. Next weekend, the 34th and final Bundesliga matchday will take place, just like in France with Ligue 1. It will be one last nerve-racking simultaneous kick-off for three teams: St. Pauli, Heidenheim, and Wolfsburg. The three teams currently occupy the bottom three spots in the table with the exact same number of points: 26! St. Pauli and Heidenheim are, for now, virtually relegated to Bundesliga 2, while Wolfsburg sit in 16th place — the relegation play-off spot — thanks to their goal difference. -29 for St. Pauli and Heidenheim, -26 for Wolfsburg. But the craziest part is the schedule for this final matchday next weekend! While Heidenheim will host Mainz, St. Pauli and Wolfsburg will face each other in an absolutely epic relegation "final.". It is a match both teams will absolutely have to win if Heidenheim win.

title: Bundesliga: Schalke relegated for first time in 30 years - DW News
content: Schalke 04 have been relegated from the Bundesliga for the first time in three decades. Defeat away to Arminia Bielefeld on Tuesday night sealed their fate.

title: Bundesliga relegation battle hits historic low points tally | theScore
content: Berlin - While Bayern Munich battle leaders Borussia Dortmund in a tense Bundesliga title race, down in the relegation zone, those fighting to stay up have hit an all-time low. Not since the Bundesliga began back in 1963 have the bottom four teams in Germany's top flight earned so few points between them. After 23 rounds of matches, the bottom four clubs -- Augsburg (18), VfB Stuttgart (16), Hannover (14) and Nurnberg (13) -- have just 61 points. The record for the lowest amount of points achieved by a side who managed to avoid relegation is 27 by Hamburg in 2013/14. Amazingly for a side involved in the knock-out stages of the Champions League, Schalke are 14th, with a five-point buffer to Augsburg who face Dortmund on Friday. However, even after one of the worst league seasons in the club's history, relegation thoughts bother only the most pessimistic of Schalke fans with the Royal Blues seven points from the bottom three. * Running analysis of the World Cup group stage.
